# znippy-zoomies

Single-purpose parallel Rust primitives built on one all-core engine, not rayon's fork-join model.

- **`gatling`** — multicore streaming engine; zero copy, allocation, I/O-wait, and CPU-pause.
- **`lgz` / `lbunzip2`** — pure-Rust parallel gzip / bzip2 decoders on gatling.
- **`stree` / `stree32`** — AVX2 static search trees, ~40 ns/query.
- **`vtd`** — parallel OSM-XML scanner → compact byte-offset index; bounded RAM.
- **`psort`** — parallel sample sort over 16-byte `i64`-keyed records.

## Decompressor benchmarks

Each of our parallel decoders against the standard tools **for its own format**, grouped by
format — every one of ours vs every one of theirs, in two modes. One deterministic 1 GB
corpus, min-of-3. Columns are hand-picked (MB/s · cores · wall s · peak RSS). A 🏆 marks a
decoder that beat a long-reigning record — see [`records.toml`](records.toml).

## OSM converter

`osm-katana` (in-repo sub-crate) converts OSM-XML/PBF → GeoParquet all-core on a no-barrier
gatling pipeline, head-to-head with the legacy reference tools `osmium` / `osmconvert` for the
same input. One convert pass, min-of-3. Columns: MB/s, cores busy, wall seconds, peak RSS (MB).

<!-- nornir:gen:start:benches cols=convert_mbs,cores_busy,convert_s,peak_mem_mb compare=osm-katana,osmium,osmconvert self=osm-katana -->
**v0.1.19 · AMD Ryzen 9 7900 12-Core Processor · 61 GiB · corpus 1024 MB · min-of-3 · 12 cores · 2026-07-13**

| workload | convert_mbs | cores_busy | convert_s | peak_mem_mb |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| osm-katana | 115.40 | 1.35 | 0.21 | 307.70 |
| osmium | 126.20 | 1.31 | 0.19 | 36.60 |
| osmconvert | 136.70 | 0.91 | 0.18 | 267.20 |
<!-- nornir:gen:end:benches -->

<sub>`convert_mbs` = input MB / wall; `cores_busy` = average CPU cores busy (12 = full saturation
on this box). `osm-katana` runs all cores; `osmium` / `osmconvert` are the single-stream C++
references, benched only when installed. By default a small synthetic OSM-XML corpus exercises the
emit path on any box — the HEADLINE number comes from the off-box planet run
(`NORNIR_OSM_KATANA_INPUT=<planet.osm> nornir bench run znippy-zoomies`). Region **clip** headline
(cut Sweden out of the planet with our tool): add `NORNIR_OSM_KATANA_CLIP=10.9,55.3,24.2,69.1`.</sub>

### Staged pipeline

The classic planet chain — each stage eats the **previous stage's output file**:
`xml2-pbf` (OSM XML/bz2 → PBF) → `pbf2-geo` (PBF → GeoParquet) → `geo2-arrow` (GeoParquet → Arrow
IPC). `NORNIR_OSM_KATANA_CHAIN=1 nornir bench run znippy-zoomies` warehouses one row per stage
(`stage_mbs` = that stage's input MB / wall); point `NORNIR_OSM_KATANA_INPUT` at a planet for the
heavy chain. Off by default — it adds a full three-stage pass — so the table lands after that run.
